chapter: Back in New York: Heard and Dizzy
title: The saxophone section and Howard Johnson in Dizzy's band
summary: He names the sax section including Howard Johnson, Cecil Payne and Gale and the brown altoist; Johnson had been to Europe in 1939 and taught him chess.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who else was playing saxophone when

Well, Howard Johnson was playing lead; Cecil Payne was playing baritone, umm, Gale was playing the other tenor and, let's see, (John) the alto player, Brown. Brown was playing the other alto. But Howard Johnson, he went to Europe with Teddy Hill with Dizzy in 1939 and he taught me how to play chess. He's quite a fellow, quite a fellow. That was a good rhythm section.
So did you stay there in Detroit for a while?
